svg.aria-label: tool-picker asking which installed connectors to use for a production check

g.font-family: Consolas, 'SF Mono', Menlo, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
g.text: ❯ anything blowing up in prod since last night?
← ☐ Prod check ✔ Submit →
Which tools should I use to check prod since last night? (They work as a set:
Vercel shows the crashes, Supabase shows the database side, Sentry and PostHog
show what real users hit.)
❯ 1. [ ] Vercel (Recommended)
Connector, working now. Reads grouped runtime errors and failed
deployments for your live sites over the last 24h. This is the most
direct answer to 'is prod broken'.
2. [ ] Supabase
Connector, working now. Reads API, Postgres, auth and edge function logs
plus security/performance advisors for your projects.
3. [ ] Sentry
Connector, still connecting when I looked. Would list new and spiking
error issues if any of your apps report to it. Datadog and PagerDuty do
the same job but both need sign-in, so I left them out.
4. [ ] PostHog
Connector, working now. Error tracking and usage drops, useful if a site
looks 'up' but users are failing silently.
5. [ ] Type something
Submit
6. Chat about this
Enter to select · ↑/↓ to navigate · Esc to cancel
